note: Scenario contract, not executed Falco engine results. See smoke.sh and tests/README.md.

scenarios.positive: shell with a controlling terminal in a test container
nginx parent executes /bin/sh in a test container
scenarios.negative: shell parent is an approved test runner, not a web process

scenarios.rule: DSO Credential file read in container
scenarios.positive: open a dummy /root/.aws/credentials in a disposable container

scenarios.rule: DSO Service account token read by utility
scenarios.positive: cat a dummy service-account token path in a test container
scenarios.negative: application process python opens the same dummy token

scenarios.positive: connect to a dummy Unix socket at /run/docker.sock inside a disposable container

scenarios.rule: DSO Executable launched from temporary directory
scenarios.positive: execute a copy of /bin/true placed at /tmp/dso-test

scenarios.rule: DSO Package manager in running container
scenarios.positive: execute apt --help in a test container

scenarios.rule: DSO Network discovery utility in container
scenarios.positive: execute a harmless nmap --version in a test container

scenarios.rule: DSO Known miner process name in container
scenarios.positive: execute a harmless test binary named xmrig
execute su --help in a test container

scenarios.rule: DSO Memory backed executable in container
scenarios.positive: execute /usr/bin/true copied to a memfd in an isolated Linux test container
an authorized test parent traces its own dummy child in a sandbox
scenarios.negative: a ptrace call denied by seccomp, or no ptrace syscall

scenarios.positive: write a dummy key to /tmp/dso-home/.ssh/authorized_keys in a disposable container
scenarios.negative: read the same dummy file without write flags

scenarios.rule: DSO Scheduler or systemd configuration modified

scenarios.positive: write a placeholder to a dummy /etc/gshadow in a disposable container
unlink a dummy /var/log/auth.log inside a disposable container
